get.description: Returns list of shop order fields that will be required by the customer to be filled in while placing the order on shop.

post.description:
Create a field that you would like users to fill in before placing an order. These fields can be kept deactivated so they don't show up while placing order by changing checked flag.
API returns list of all fields for this shop with their status.
The field type by default will be set to "text".

label.description: The name of this field that the customer will see in the shop or is visible in the POS app

checked.description: Whether this field is required when completing an order

delete.description:
Delete an order field that you would like users to fill in before placing an order. 
API returns list of all fields for this shop with their status.

patch.description:
Update an order field that you would like users to fill in before placing an order. 
The update operation is essentially to activate or deactivate the field.
API returns list of all fields for this shop with their status.

checked.description: Whether this field is required when completing an order
